currency_note: Prices are single-unit list prices exactly as shown on each product page on 2026-09-29, in that page's currency (USD for US/CN/KR storefronts, GBP for UK storefronts). No currency conversion is applied. Quantity discounts, VAT/tax, shipping and stock levels are not captured. Prices change; re-check the product page before buying.
scope_note: 8 retailers that sell robotics parts directly to the public online (hobby, maker, education, components), 8-12 items each, spread across 8 normalised categories. General marketplaces (Amazon, eBay, AliExpress) excluded. Skipped: RobotShop and DigiKey (HTTP 403 to automated fetching), Mouser (bot-check page instead of content); Pimoroni and The Pi Hut were reachable but dropped to keep the scope at 8 stores. Every item comes from a product page fetched on the capture date; fields not visible on the page are null.
